source_title: A Standard Platform Fee For New Creators Effective After August 4 2025
snippet_primary: "This policy is effective for creators who publish their creator page after August 4, 2025. If you are a creator who publishes your page on or before August 4, 2025, you will keep your existing platform pricing — this new plan will not apply to you, and you will not see a change in price as a result of this change."
subject_exact: Patreon help center states new standard platform fee applies only to creators who publish after August 4, 2025; existing creators publishing on or before August 4, 2025 retain legacy pricing
local_qualifiers: new standard platform fee: applies to creators publishing after August 4, 2025
grandfathered: creators published on or before August 4, 2025 keep existing pricing
parser_notes: Patreon help center — Standard Platform Fee (updated January 28, 2026). Fee change effective August 4, 2025; existing creators grandfathered at legacy pricing. Defines the two-tier creator population (pre/post-August 4, 2025).
